leadText:
Taylor (Japanese: テツオ Tetsuo) is a character of the day who appeared in Pursuing a Lofty Goal!.

Taylor was 's first opponent in the Squallville PokéRinger competition. During their match, he used his against Ash's Staravia. It nearly defeated Staravia with an attack, but a gust of wind pushed Staravia out of the way in time. Taylor commanded another Air Cutter, but Staravia dodged it and landed the ring on the goal, resulting in his loss.
